title: 7-Day High-Intensity Workout Plan for Fat Loss & Muscle Gain
description: This plan focuses on compound exercises to maximize calorie burn and muscle engagement. Remember to adjust the intensity based on your fitness level and consult a doctor before starting any new workout routine. Proper nutrition is crucial for achieving your goals, so ensure you're supporting your training with a healthy diet.

days.title: Day 1: Upper Body Strength
days.warmup: Jumping jacks (60 seconds), high knees (30 seconds), arm circles (forward and backward, 30 seconds each), dynamic stretches like arm swings and torso twists (1 min).
days.cooldown: Static stretches holding each for 30 seconds (chest, back, biceps, triceps, shoulders).

days.title: Day 2: Lower Body & Core
days.warmup: Bodyweight squats (15 reps), lunges (10 reps per leg), glute bridges (15 reps), plank (30 seconds).
days.cooldown: Foam roll quads, hamstrings, and glutes. Static stretches for hip flexors, hamstrings, and glutes (30 seconds each).

days.title: Day 3: HIIT Cardio & Core
days.warmup: Light cardio, like jogging or jumping jacks, followed by dynamic stretches.
days.cooldown: 5 minutes light walk, child's pose, cobra stretch, and seated forward reach.

days.title: Day 4: Active Recovery & Mobility
days.warmup: 5 minutes gentle neck rolls, shoulder rolls, and hip openers.
days.cooldown: Full-body foam rolling (quads, hamstrings, lats) and 5 minutes diaphragmatic breathing.

days.title: Day 5: Upper Body Hypertrophy
days.warmup: Band pull-aparts (20 reps), arm swings, and 10 controlled push-ups.
days.cooldown: Chest doorframe stretch, overhead tricep stretch, and cross-arm shoulder stretch.

days.title: Day 6: Lower Body Power & Conditioning
days.warmup: Dynamic leg swings, bodyweight squats, and glute bridge marches.
days.cooldown: Foam roll IT band, quads, and calves. Deep runner's lunge and butterfly stretch.

days.title: Day 7: Full Body HIIT & Core Burnout
days.warmup: Jumping jacks, butt kicks, arm pulses, and high knee marches (5 mins).
days.cooldown: 10 minutes slow yoga stretches: child's pose, cobra, downward dog, and seated forward fold.
